  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. title: Marketing Analyst
description:
Overview

Marketing Analyst role at Winona . We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Marketing Analyst to help us make smarter decisions, faster. You’ll own the data behind our customer journey — from first impression to conversion — and help us understand what’s working, what’s not, and where the biggest growth opportunities lie. You’ll work closely with the growth, creative, and product teams to set up funnel tracking, evaluate creative performance, conduct competitive research, and uncover insights that fuel smarter acquisition strategies. Your work will directly influence spend allocation, campaign development, and optimization decisions.

About Winona

Winona is one of the leading telemedicine companies providing HRT for women in menopause. We’ve built all of our technology in house including an EHR, patient care admin system, patient portal, website, marketing technology etc. Winona has two compounding pharmacies and a team of in house physicians providing world-class care via a fully vertically integrated business model.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and monitor full-funnel tracking — from ad click to sign-up to retention
  • Build and maintain dashboards that surface conversion rates, drop-off points, and cohort behavior
  • Partner with growth and product teams to recommend A/B tests and UX improvements
  • Analyze the performance of paid media and content campaigns across channels (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, email)
  • Break down creative effectiveness by format, hook, CTA, and audience segment
  • Surface actionable recommendations on what’s working and where to iterate
  • Monitor competitor strategies, ad libraries, landing pages, messaging, and offers
  • Compile and present intelligence that helps shape our own positioning, messaging, and creative tests
  • Create weekly/monthly marketing performance reports with both high-level summaries and deep dives
  • Work cross-functionally to connect marketing metrics with product, sales, and lifecycle KPIs
  • Help build forecasting models and identify underperforming segments

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a marketing analytics or growth analytics role (bonus if in a startup or high-growth environment)
  • Strong understanding of marketing attribution, funnel dynamics, and customer journeys
  • Proficiency in tools like Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or similar event-based analytics platforms
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with SQL or BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) is a plus
  • Highly comfortable working with cross-functional teams, asking good questions, and influencing decisions with data
  • Bonus: exposure to paid media platforms, email performance analytics, or customer segmentation

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexible hours
  • Work wherever you choose
  • Fun and casual work environment
  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings
  • We are a diverse, global team!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Winona provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected classification. Equal employment opportunity extends to all aspects of employment including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, demotion, transfer, leaves of absence, and termination. Winona takes allegations of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation seriously and will promptly investigate such behaviors.

Company Description

M3 Global Research

Job Description
The Project Delivery Assistant is responsible for strategizing custom recruiting actions for Quant and Qual projects, assigning recruiting tasks, and monitoring recruiting activities to ensure projects are delivered accurately within deadlines. The Project Delivery Assistant works across project teams to understand recruiting needs of assigned projects and execute strategy to ensure sample is achieved in accordance with the client’s expectations and established company profit targets. Project Delivery Assistant may execute custom recruitment actions directly, assign tasks to colleagues, and work with managers on larger recruiting initiatives.

  • Manage custom recruitment for 25 or more live projects including complex projects, and challenging recruiting targets, expanding knowledge and experience on market research recruitment for quantitative and qualitative studies.
  • Attending Internal Kick-off (IKO) meetings when necessary to discuss and outline recruiting plans and timelines for successful execution of projects.
  • Create a custom recruiting strategy on projects assigned, initiate and/or execute tasks as outlined, monitoring progress, and adjusting recruiting strategy to ensure the maximum internal sample is achieved to meet client needs and maintain profit targets.
  • Recommend alternative internal sampling strategies to maximize internal completes.
  • Communicate recruitment updates, status, and issues to internal project teams through email, meetings or as agreed in regular intervals.
  • Proactively seek alternative sample and recruiting strategies, providing ideas to improve response rate and reduce costs in each project.
  • Have an excellent understanding of the M3 sampling, emailing, and reporting tools to ensure they are used to the best of their capabilities in supporting project deliverability.
  • Provide constructive feedback to the line manager and assist in bringing ideas on areas where M3 sampling, emailing, and reporting tools can be improved in their functionality.
  • Ensure that KPIs including but not limited outsource rates, panel recruitment and quality scores are achieved monthly.
  • Assist the team in developing custom recruitment strategies to grow membership of the M3 Global Research panel.

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: The Role
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Junior Email Marketing Specialist to support our growing CRM & Email Marketing team at Ruby Labs. This is an exciting opportunity to kickstart or deepen your career in digital marketing by contributing to impactful lifecycle campaigns across multiple fast-growing brands.
You’ll work closely with our CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager and Marketing Director to execute email workflows, A/B tests, localisations, and campaign performance tracking. You will learn and work with tools like Customer.io and Mixpanel , helping us increase engagement, retention, and conversions across all Ruby Labs brands.
Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Setup & Automation: Build and launch email campaigns and automated workflows inside Customer.io based on provided briefs, templates, and copy.
  • A/B Testing: Set up A/B tests on subject lines, content, and CTAs to help optimise open rates and conversion rates.
  • Email Localisation: Coordinate and implement localisation of email content across multiple languages supported by our products, using AI tools and localisation guidelines.
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Track email performance metrics (open rate, CTR, CVR, unsubscribe rate, etc.) using tools like Mixpanel and Customer.io. Compile weekly reports and flag trends or anomalies.
  • Operational Support: Support the Marketing team with routine QA, list hygiene, tagging, and UTM tracking to ensure clean execution and data accuracy.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with designers, product teams, and data analysts to ensure campaigns are on-brand, accurate, and effective.
Qualifications
  • Experience: 1–2 years of hands-on experience in email marketing, CRM, digital marketing, or marketing operations.
  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with Customer.io or similar tools (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Braze, etc.). Exposure to Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or other data tools is a plus. Basic understanding of A/B testing and segmentation
  • Language & Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Experience working with or localising multi-language content is a plus
  • Mindset & Soft Skills: Fast learner with a passion for email marketing. Detail-oriented and process-driven. Proactive attitude and ability to work independently. Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks
Location
Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.
Benefits
Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:
  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:
Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!
Interview Process
  • Application Submission: Provide your CV along with examples of past email marketing campaigns, automations, and results achieved.
  • Recruiter Screening (30 minutes): Discuss your background, experience, and fit for the role.
  • Task Assignment: Demonstrate your skills with a practical task related to email flows, segmentation, and A/B testing strategy.
  • Final Interview (60 minutes): Meet with the Marketing Director to discuss your vision for the role and potential impact at Ruby Labs.

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to our Data Platform team in Brazil (Remote) !

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

This is an established team with a strong culture that expects collaboration, humbleness, accountability, empathy, and a sense of humor.

Some ongoing and future projects

YOUR IMPACT

WHO YOU ARE

  • Knowledge of analytical data warehouses

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Mainframe Application & Testing Engineer

Apply remote type Fully Remote locations Hortolandia, São Paulo, Brazil time type Full time posted on Posted Today job requisition id R-39181

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role

Kyndryl is seeking a Mainframe Application & Testing Engineer with strong programming and database knowledge, robust testing methodology, and excellent debugging skills. This role is essential for ensuring reliable, high-quality application delivery in mission-critical enterprise systems.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and testing mainframe applications, supporting end-to-end software delivery, and ensuring compliance with quality and governance standards.

Responsibilites:

  • Develop and support mainframe applications using COBOL, PL/I, Assembler, Easytrieve, and REXX/CLIST.
  • Write and debug JCL for batch processing and job automation.
  • Perform database operations and validations using DB2, IMS DB, and IDMS.
  • Test online applications running on CICS and IMS DC.
  • Conduct unit, integration, regression, and performance testing.
  • Support UAT cycles and assist users with test execution and defect resolution.
  • Use debugging tools (Abend-AID, Xpediter, IBM Debug Tool) and data utilities (SORT, IDCAMS, IEBGENER).
  • Manage source code and packages using Panvalet, ChangeMan, Endevor, and Git.
  • Document test cases, results, and root cause analyses.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth application delivery.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Skills and Experience:

1. Mainframe Technical Skills

  • z/OS environment: Strong knowledge of TSO/ISPF, SDSF, datasets (PS, PDS, VSAM).
  • JCL (Job Control Language): Writing, modifying, and debugging jobs.
  • Programming languages: COBOL (most common for business apps); PL/I, Assembler, RPG, Easytrieve (depending on the system) and REXX/CLIST (for automation).
  • Databases: DB2, IMS DB, IDMS — querying, data validation, and test data setup.
  • Transaction monitors: CICS, IMS DC — testing online applications.

2. Application Development & Support

  • Understanding of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and Agile/Waterfall models.
  • Application analysis, enhancements, and defect fixing.
  • Code review and integration with source management tools (Panvalet, ChangeMan, Endevor).

3. Testing Skills

  • Unit Testing: Verifying individual modules/programs.
  • System Integration Testing (SIT): Validating interfaces and data flows across components.
  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support: Assisting users with test cycles.
  • Regression Testing: Ensuring fixes/enhancements don’t break existing functionality.
  • Performance Testing: Analyzing job run-times, CICS response times, DB performance.

4. Tools & Utilities

  • File & Data utilities: SORT, IDCAMS, IEBGENER, IEBCOPY for test data creation.
  • Debugging tools: IBM Debug Tool, Abend-AID, Xpediter, File-AID.
  • Test management tools: HP ALM/QC, Jira, or equivalent.
  • Version control/SCM tools: Panvalet, ChangeMan, Endevor, Git (in hybrid environments).

5. Quality & Process Knowledge

  • Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
  • Compliance & audit standards (SOX, PCI, etc., depending on industry).
  • Automation in testing: Using REXX, CLIST, or Python (in hybrid mainframe setups).


Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learningprograms give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, includingMicrosoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

description:

A Amaná Investimentos, parceira oficial da XP Investimentos, está em busca de Assessores de Investimentos com certificação ANCORD ativa para atuar de forma 100% remota. Se você é apaixonado por mercado financeiro, valoriza autonomia e busca alta rentabilidade, esta é a sua chance de se destacar em um escritório com estrutura premium para PJ2 e um dos melhores planos de comissão para PJ1. Na Amaná, você terá liberdade para gerenciar sua carteira de clientes sem metas individuais, sem "dia do produto" e sem horários fixos, contando com o suporte robusto da XP Investimentos, líder no mercado financeiro brasileiro.

Construir relacionamentos duradouros: Identificar necessidades financeiras e oferecer soluções personalizadas, utilizando o amplo portfólio da XP, incluindo produtos de investimento e soluções PJ2 (consórcios, seguros, crédito).

Por Que Escolher a Amaná?

Comissões altamente competitivas: Repasses acima da média para produtos de investimento e estrutura otimizada para PJ2, com plano de repasses líder de mercado para PJ1 e PJ2.

Flexibilidade total: Trabalhe sem metas impostas, sem "dia do produto" e com liberdade para definir seus horários, além de autonomia para definir, junto com os clientes, a melhor alocação para cada perfil.

Suporte premium: Acesso à plataforma da XP Investimentos e ao apoio técnico e estratégico da Amaná.

Trabalho 100% remoto: Atue de qualquer lugar, com total liberdade geográfica.

Cultura de excelência: Faça parte de uma equipe que valoriza inovação, autonomia e resultados.

Certificação ANCORD ativa (obrigatória).

Perfil empreendedor: Profissionais proativos, organizados e motivados por resultados.

Habilidades interpessoais: Excelente comunicação e capacidade de construir confiança com clientes.

Conhecimento do mercado: Familiaridade com renda fixa, renda variável, fundos, consórcios, seguros e crédito.

Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Gestão Financeira ou áreas afins (desejável, não eliminatório).

Experiência: Atuação prévia em assessoria de investimentos ou mercado financeiro é um diferencial.

Como Você Se Encaixa

Como Assessor(a) de Investimentos na Amaná, você será peça-chave para conectar clientes às melhores soluções financeiras da XP, contribuindo para o crescimento do escritório. Com a liberdade de um modelo autônomo e o respaldo de uma estrutura sólida, você terá todas as ferramentas para alcançar resultados excepcionais e construir uma carreira de sucesso no mercado financeiro.

Se você possui certificação ANCORD ativa, espírito empreendedor e deseja atuar em um ambiente de alta performance com altos repasses de comissão, envie seu currículo e uma breve apresentação para ou candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Venha fazer parte da Amaná Investimentos e transforme sua carreira!

A Amaná Investimentos, credenciada pela XP Investimentos, é um escritório com sede em São Paulo, SP , focado em oferecer soluções financeiras personalizadas com transparência e excelência. Estagiário de Design Gráfico - Criação de Mídias Digitais

Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio.

Interessados, por favor, leiam até o final para verificar os requisitos necessários para a vaga.

Requisito Obrigatório: Para que o candidato seja considerado para a vaga de estágio, é imprescindível que entre em contato com sua instituição de ensino, manifeste interesse pelo estágio e solicite a eles o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio. Este documento é obrigatório para a efetivação da contratação. Sem o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio, não será possível concluir o processo de seleção e iniciar o estágio.

Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h

Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia, totalizando uma média de R$ 1.380.

Informações adicionais: A posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Requisito obrigatório: Estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas.

Você é uma pessoa disponível, responsável, proativa, criativa, organizada e cheia de vontade de aprender? Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Principais responsabilidades incluem auxiliar na criação de arte para diversas mídias digitais, como Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, e-mail marketing, folders, cartões de visita, entre outros. Será proporcionado treinamento e acompanhamento por um profissional experiente para garantir um desenvolvimento eficaz.

É fundamental possuir internet de alta velocidade no local de trabalho, além de pró-atividade, bom humor, apetite por desafios e disposição para aprender.

Perfil Desejado

  • Cursar graduação em Marketing, Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas é obrigatório.
  • Bom conhecimento de português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto.
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital.
  • Entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram.
  • Muita responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente.
  • Responsabilidade e capacidade de se auto-gerenciar, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidas.
  • Conhecimento básico em edição de imagem e vídeo, com bom senso estético.
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe.
  • Familiaridade com programas de edição como Photoshop, Canva, Corel.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho será valorizada.

Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais.
  • Edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok.
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior.
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok.
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas.
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação para o e-mail indicado, com o assunto: "Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome". Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, acrescente exemplos de artes que você já tenha produzido e destaque seu potencial para crescer como um membro valioso de nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudá-lo a desenvolver suas habilidades em Design Gráfico.

Quem somos?

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão e buscamos pessoas que gostem de trabalhar, tenham interesse em comunicação, sejam criativas e não tenham medo de enfrentar novos desafios. Valorizamos profissionais éticos e responsáveis, dispostos a somar ao nosso time.

Acreditamos na importância da diversidade e inclusão e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias, representando a pluralidade do nosso país. Acreditamos que uma equipe formada por indivíduos diversos nos torna mais criativos e inovadores.

What Clinical Operations Site Management Does At Worldwide
Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) play a vital role in ensuring our clinical research programs are executed with the quality and excellence our sponsors expect and the care and passion patients deserve.
These roles are the backbone of every strong CRO, helping drive breakthrough scientific research and playing a lead role in every clinical trial. All CROs will promise you growth, opportunity, and maybe even a challenge. But we offer more than that. We offer an uncommon experience – one you can’t get anywhere else, with a team unlike anyone else.
At Worldwide, we balance fun with the serious business of changing lives. We have a values-driven culture that is built from the ground up. We empower our team members to treat every trial like a patient’s life depends on it – because it does. Our leaders are in the trenches with you, committed to advancing science and moving mountains for our customers.

Overview

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Arlington, VA; Jefferson, VA

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

Position levels

  • Sales Specialist : $115,000.00 - requires 1+ years of sales experience with at least 1 year in pharmaceutical, and/or other related healthcare sales, with an emphasis on neuroscience preferred.
  • Sales Specialist : $135,000.00 - requires a minimum of 5+ years of healthcare sales with at least 2 years of experience in complex or account-based selling environments is required.

  • Experience in Apheresis Operations Management, QA Operations, GMP production, GTP or other relevant operational areas (E) Breadth of experience in regulated (GxP) environment, understanding of HTA (either hospital or pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical company) (E)
  • Experience working in Apheresis, Cellular Therapy or Stem Cell Transplant programs (P)

Qualifications

Skills/Specialist knowledge

title: Lingo Regional Sales Manager - East
description:
Overview

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Regional Sales Manager, Lingo- East

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

Lingo is a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers – such as glucose, ketones, and lactate – to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize, and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.

The Lingo Regional Sales Manager ensures that the assigned region meets or exceeds sales and profitability objectives. Formulates sales strategies for markets within the assigned geography and product lines in order to attain revenue goals set by the company. Works with sales representatives to identify and evaluate market opportunities and sales potential and to establish and achieve their annual sales objectives. Your actions and decisions consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering measurable business outcomes—you will be a proactive partner in client success, maintaining clear and transparent communication about performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations. This ongoing engagement builds trust, strengthens client relationships, and positions CTC as a strategic leader in performance marketing.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As an Ecommerce Growth Manager, you set a high standard, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and a results-focused approach.

You thrive on challenges, take ownership of outcomes, and are committed to building, optimizing, and scaling high-performance marketing strategies. We embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take full responsibility, drive excellence, and always deliver results.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.

Critical Thinking

Impact

Results

  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as an Ecommerce Growth Manager, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.

title: Environmental Compliance Specialist
description:
Overview

At Fluor, we are proud to design and build projects and careers. We are committed to fostering a welcoming and collaborative work environment that encourages big-picture thinking, brings out the best in our employees, and helps us develop innovative solutions that contribute to building a better world together. If this sounds like a culture you would like to work in, you're invited to apply for this role.

Job Description

Fluor is seeking candidates for opportunities within our Program Delivery Support (PDS) team, working alongside the California High-Speed Rail Authority, to provide program delivery and program management services for one of the largest planned infrastructure projects in the U.S. The system will connect the 500-mile stretch between the Los Angeles region with the San Francisco Bay Area, with up to 24 stations. The first phase of the program is currently under construction in California's Central Valley.

Under the general direction of the PDS Assistant and Deputy Assistant Environmental Services Managers and the Authority Director of Environmental Services, the Environmental Compliance Specialist works in the Program Delivery group, which is part of the California High-Speed Rail Authority's (Authority's) Office of Program Delivery, Environmental Services Branch and reports directly to the Deputy Assistant Environmental Services Manager. The Environmental Compliance Specialist will work closely with the Environmental Compliance Manager to conduct data entry and prepare reports in the Authority's proprietary environmental compliance database management application.

The Environmental Compliance Specialist will work closely with the Environmental Compliance Manager to conduct data entry and prepare reports in the Authority's proprietary environmental compliance database management application, EMMA. In this role, the Environmental Compliance Specialist will analyze and enter the Authority's environmental commitments as documented in the Mitigation, Monitoring, and Reporting Plan and regulatory permits into EMMA and support compliance implementation, documentation, and reporting for project sections under construction.

The Environmental Compliance Specialist is responsible for coding environmental commitments from environmental and permit approval documents into the Authority's Environmental Mitigation Management Assessment database application (EMMA), preparing reports in EMMA to identify gaps and document mitigation compliance, and supporting the Environmental Compliance Manager to use EMMA for construction compliance demonstration.

  • Familiarity with NEPA, CEQA, and permits and approvals under Sections 401 and 404 of the Clean Water Act, Section 7 of the federal Endangered Species Act, Section 2081 of the California Endangered Species Act, and Section 1600 of the California Fish & Game Code, among others
  • Interact with regulatory agency staff to answer routine construction compliance questions
  • Assist with document controls in SharePoint and other applications

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing; bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Você será protagonista na gestão estratégica de escolas de grande porte que já utilizam o isaac. Seu papel vai muito além da manutenção da carteira: será responsável por impulsionar crescimento sustentável, maximizar o valor percebido e construir parcerias de longo prazo.   • Liderar a estratégia da frente de grandes contas, conectando visão de negócio, relacionamento consultivo e expansão de receita.

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com mantenedores e tomadores de decisão, atuando como referência de confiança e geração de valor.

  • Diagnosticar cenários financeiros e operacionais para propor soluções alinhadas ao nosso portfólio.

  • Conduzir negociações complexas , envolvendo múltiplos stakeholders.

  • Acompanhar KPIs críticos, identificar riscos e oportunidades, e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.

  • Desenhar e evoluir processos da frente de grandes contas , com foco em eficiência, escalabilidade e encantamento.

  • Futuramente, estruturar e liderar um time, com responsabilidade pelo desenvolvimento, capacitação e performance da equipe.

Experiência sólida com Customer Success, KAM ou gestão de grandes contas , com resultados comprovados em retenção e expansão.

Histórico de liderança formal ou informal , com visão estratégica e capacidade de estruturação.

Habilidade em negociações de alto impacto , com múltiplos stakeholders.

Raciocínio lógico e analítico bem desenvolvido; domínio de indicadores financeiros e operacionais .

Perfil altamente consultivo, com foco em relacionamento e geração de valor.

Excelente comunicação e postura executiva.

Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Zendesk ou similares) e ferramentas de BI.

Diferenciais que brilham os olhos:

  • Experiência anterior em empresas SaaS, fintechs ou de tecnologia B2B .

  • Atuação no setor educacional (escolas, mantenedoras, edtechs).

  • Vivência com indicadores financeiros e viabilidade de negócios .

  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas .

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vemproisaac

title: Technology and Product Senior Software Engineer | CODE Brazil (Remote)
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer for our Booking team in Brazil!

CODE is an acronym for Consumer Digital Experience, which means we\'re in charge of the experience and services that will guide people\'s well-being journey. Our main goal in CODE is to make well-being universal. From knowing about Wellhub and getting access to exclusive benefits to using our vast partner network, it is all about the end-user experience.

The Check-in & Booking team enables users to use our partners’ services in a fast, easy, and frictionless way. We are responsible for developing and maintaining Wellhub\'s App, frontend, and backend services, and Design System, and work closely with product, UX, and data teams to create an excellent experience for the users of our platform.

Your Impact

Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer and shape our product\'s future. You\'ll architect, build, and deploy high-quality solutions, driving impactful improvements in a fast-paced agile setting. Lead technical discussions, mentor developers, and ensure code excellence through thorough reviews. Champion data-driven decisions, prioritize simplicity, and bring innovative ideas to life. Elevate your technical expertise and communication skills while contributing to our company\'s success.

  • Driven to deliver timely, high-quality work. Perform insightful pull-request reviews and build reusable code
  • Be data-driven and participate in and/or lead architectural decisions, share improvement opportunities, bring innovation to the table, and make sure design docs are up to date
  • Promote the long-term technical health of our journeys
  • Take part in incident resolution and troubleshooting in the production environment
  • Take ownership of critical features, be accountable, and possess a high level of ownership by following up on engineering SLOs and product KPIs
  • Interact with the product team and stakeholders to impact the business
  • Mentoring other engineers
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who You Are

  • A true team player who loves working towards both team and individual goals with at least 5 years of experience in web development.
  • An engineer with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience in designing and developing modern web applications
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java / Kotlin / Scala). Scala will be considered a plus
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, understanding common use cases, and performance pitfalls
  • Experience dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS, etc., and an in-depth understanding of their use cases and pitfalls
  • Experience with microservices and high-volume distributed systems
  • Experience with Cloud-based architectures in AWS
  • Strong communication skills, including verbal and written English and Portuguese

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in backend programming languages and AWS are mandatory requirements.

What We Offer You

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page!

Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

description:
Overview

National Consultant for the development of Risk Communication toolkit and course, Brasilia (home-based), Brazil, (6 months).

Join to apply for the National Consultant role at UNICEF. In conflict and disaster, children suffer first and suffer most. UNICEF works to strengthen the links between humanitarian action and development work, delivering a continuum of support. In Brazil, UNICEF supports child-centred disaster risk reduction interventions and emergency responses, such as the Venezuelan migration outflow and the drought in the Amazon Region. In the last two years, UNICEF contributed to the Yanomami public health emergency and the response to the floods in Rio Grande do Sul. UNICEF’s crosscutting focus includes Social and Behaviour Change (SBC), and Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) is a key component of preparedness and response.

Under the guidance of the Social and Behaviour Change Officer, in coordination with the Emergency Specialist and the RCCE Specialist, the consultant will support UNICEF in producing a Toolkit and course on Risk Communication and Community Engagement in Brazil, liaising with all field offices that respond to humanitarian situations in the country. The consultancy covers a 6-month period and aims to develop an RCCE Toolkit and a short RCCE course for public managers involved in emergency preparedness and response in Brazil.

Work assignments and deliverables

  • RCCE Toolkit: Mapping — Map UNICEF's existing materials/tools since 2018 (migration response, COVID-19, and recent emergencies) and organize the materials in an online repository. Deliverables include a cloud-based, catalogued repository and a document listing mapped materials. Timeline: after 30 days of contract signature. Budget: 10% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Message Matrix — Develop a comprehensive matrix with child-centered key messages by emergency type (drought, smoke/fires, floods) for each of the five UNICEF Goal Areas (Health and Nutrition, WASH, Education, Child Protection, Social Policy). Messages will be used for advocacy and field contexts; the template will be developed in coordination with UNICEF. Deliverables: a spreadsheet with priority messages per type of emergency and area. Timeline: after 60 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • Child-centred RCCE Course — Develop an 8-hour training course (with 4-hour and 2-hour options) in Portuguese, including at least one practical co-construction exercise. Provide an online version adapted for the EV.G platform, with two short tutorial videos. The consultant is not responsible for platform programming but will provide scripts. Deliverables include facilitator’s guide, participant workbook, planning checklist, presentation, and online course script with quizzes and media guidelines. Timeline: after 90 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Testing — Conduct pretesting of key messages and draft materials with affected populations and local partners, with no travel required (UNICEF will implement in selected locations). Deliverables: short report on testing, methodologies, and adaptations. Timeline: after 120 days. Budget: 15% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Materials — Produce final materials for the toolkit (25 posters, 25 card series, 25 flyers, 25 radio scripts) with a user guide and a cloud repository for high-quality PDFs, PNGs, and .doc files. Timeline: after 150 days. Budget: 35% of consultancy fee.

Travel plan

No travel planned for this consultancy.

Minimum qualifications

  • A university degree in social and behavioural sciences, social communication, sociology, anthropology, psychology, education, public relations, or related field.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in RCCE, CwC, SBC, C4D or related areas; experience in humanitarian settings and producing content for affected populations; portfolio required.
  • Knowledge of children’s rights issues (CRC and the Statute of the Child and Adolescent is an asset).
  • Ability to manage relationships with partners, including government counterparts and communities; strong writing and communication skills in Portuguese.
  • Experience in a UN system agency or humanitarian/development organization is an asset.

Language proficiency

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English is an asset.

Financial proposal

  • Financial proposal must include all-inclusive fees (lump sum, travel costs, subsistence) based on deliverables and days requested.

Remarks

UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability guide all work. UNICEF provides inclusive accommodation where possible. UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on exploitation, abuse, discrimination, and safeguarding; background checks may be required. Consultants are responsible for visa and health insurance and for tax obligations according to local laws. SARS-CoV-2 vaccination status may be required for on-site assignments.

description:
Overview

Sobre a Allintra

A Allintra é uma startup brasileira de tecnologia com uma missão ambiciosa: transformar a forma como o trading de criptoativos é feito no Brasil. Estamos construindo uma plataforma de investimento de nível profissional, inteligente e colaborativa conectando traders experientes a investidores em um ecossistema seguro, transparente e poderoso. Estamos no momento mais decisivo da nossa jornada: o lançamento do Beta Test privado da plataforma. E para garantir que essa fase seja inesquecível para nossos primeiros 500 usuários, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por experiência do cliente, tecnologia e construção de comunidade.

Sua missão

Você será a ponte entre nossos usuários e o time Allintra. Vai garantir que os traders se sintam ouvidos, valorizados e empoderados, transformando seus feedbacks em decisões estratégicas de produto. Durante o lançamento, será responsável por cultivar uma comunidade ativa, acompanhar a jornada dos primeiros usuários e traduzir suas experiências em insights acionáveis. Você irá atuar diretamente na construção da jornada dos usuários reais, desenvolvendo processos de engajamento, estruturando canais de escuta e ajudando a consolidar uma cultura de produto centrada no cliente. Mais do que suporte, buscamos o protagonista na criação de experiências que encantem, envolvem e gerem valor real.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na estruturação da experiência contínua dos usuários da plataforma, garantindo um atendimento encantador e proativo.
  • Ser o ponto focal de relacionamento com os usuários e clientes do Allintra, garantindo engajamento, acolhimento e suporte proativo.
  • Manter a escuta ativa da comunidade de usuários, identificando comportamentos, desafios e oportunidades de evolução de produto.
  • Acompanhar a jornada de uso e mapear pontos de atrito ou oportunidades de encantamento dos usuários.
  • Coletar feedbacks via formulários, entrevistas e 1:1s com usuários, transformando as percepções em relatórios estruturados e acionáveis para as áreas de Produto e Marketing.
  • Conduzir réguas de comunicação (convites, atualizações, avisos de melhorias), reforçando o vínculo dos usuários com a evolução da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver processos de CX escaláveis, desde fluxos de boas-vindas até estratégias de encantamento, retenção e ativação de usuários reais.
  • Apoiar a implementação de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn reasons) e propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks reais.
  • Participar da construção de estratégias de fidelização contínua dos clientes, sempre colocando a experiência no centro das decisões.
  • Identificar usuários influentes para transformá-los em promotores da marca os primeiros Allintra Pioneers.

O que buscamos

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

  • The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of data analysis, reporting, and visualization, as well as the ability to effectively communicate insights to clients. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining reports that directly impact client business performance, conducting deep dive analyses, and translating complex data into actionable insights. You will work directly with marketing tools and platforms to access campaign data, build compelling presentations, and identify optimization opportunities across multiple channels.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain automated reports for eComm, B2B, and B2C with performance metrics across all marketing channels based on client needs and our recommendations
  • Access and analyze data directly from marketing platforms (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.) to identify meaningful performance insights
  • Create and update weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance decks with a focus on data storytelling and actionable recommendations
  • Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover optimization opportunities and answer specific business questions
  • Transform complex data into clear, concise visualizations that effectively communicate performance to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Utilize Google Sheets and other tools for sophisticated data manipulation and analysis
  • Simplify and present findings eloquently with a focus on connecting data to business outcomes
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance reporting capabilities and generate deeper insights
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem to enhance reporting capabilities

Role Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics or digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, campaign structures, and customer journey
  • Familiarity with major digital marketing platforms (Meta, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.)
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills for data manipulation and analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, or Google Data Studio
  • Understanding of statistical concepts like regression modeling, test/control analysis, etc.
  • Experience creating performance presentations and conveying data narratives
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Self-motivated and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Task Delivery Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed on or before delivery date
  • Task Accuracy Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed successfully on initial delivery (tasks not re-opened for inaccuracies or missed requirements)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Data Storytelling and Insight Generation: Transform raw data into meaningful narratives that highlight key performance indicators, trends, and actionable recommendations. Connect marketing metrics to business outcomes in a way that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Marketing Channel Expertise: Maintain deep understanding of digital marketing platforms, metrics, and campaign structures. Stay current with platform changes and be able to contextualize performance data within the broader marketing strategy.
  • Client Communication and Reporting Excellence: Develop clear, visually appealing reports and presentations that effectively communicate performance insights. Proactively identify opportunities, address client questions, and maintain regular communication regarding deliverables and timelines.
  • Continuous Improvement of Reporting Systems: Constantly seek ways to enhance reporting templates, dashboards, and analysis methodologies. Streamline reporting processes, improve visualization techniques, and incorporate new metrics to provide more comprehensive performance insights.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. This role is less about advanced analytics and coding, and more about ensuring customer data is clean, structured, and seamlessly integrated (primarily using Excel and Google Sheets).

Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes.

Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know-how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado.

Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001 , garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como *Product Manager*. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!


Main responsibilities

01. Gestão do Backlog e Demandas: Priorizar, organizar e acompanhar a fila de demandas do TMS, garantindo que as solicitações estejam alinhadas com as prioridades estratégicas e operacionais.

02. Governança do Produto: Definir e manter padrões, processos e políticas de uso do TMS, assegurando conformidade e eficácia na entrega de valor.

03. Comunicação com Stakeholders: Manter contato constante com stakeholders internos (como equipes de operação, TI, comercial) e externos (clientes, fornecedores) para entender necessidades, alinhar expectativas e comunicar status de entregas.

04. Visibilidade e Transparência: Gerar relatórios de progresso, dashboards e atualizações regulares para garantir que todos os envolvidos tenham uma visão clara do andamento do produto e das entregas.

05. Gestão do Roadmap: Elaborar, manter e comunicar o roadmap do produto, alinhando as expectativas e prioridades, além de garantir o cumprimento dos prazos.

06. Coordenação dos POs e Times de Desenvolvimento: Liderar e orientar os Product Owners e equipes de desenvolvimento, facilitando a condução dos sprints, revisões e entregas dentro do processo ágil ou tradicional adotado.

07. Condução do Processo de Delivery: Assegurar que as entregas ocorram de forma eficiente, dentro do escopo, tempo e qualidade definidos, promovendo melhorias contínuas no processo.

08. Alinhamento com Estratégia de Negócios: Garantir que o desenvolvimento e melhorias do TMS estejam alinhados às metas estratégicas do negócio e às necessidades de seus clientes.

  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Habilidades Interpessoais:

  • Forte perfil de relacionamento, com facilidade para compreender e atender às necessidades dos clientes transportadores e internos.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?
